scope: SubscribeGroup Unicode parser actual loopback HTTP -> durable subscription.added -> ordinary cmd/server --plugin-worker -> subscription/history transaction -> HTTP readback. Regression tests cover prior added/downloaded/receipt restart/cache/authority/selected-intent paths.
new_layer: One App end-to-end test, no production changes from production_base.

retained_failure.meaning: Initial new test incorrectly expected no core subscription-created notice. Existing core behavior emits one. Corrected test requires exactly one owned-loopback notice, original title and authenticated same-subscription identity. This is a test expectation failure, not a product red/green.

safety: Owned loopback HTTP, synthetic metadata/downloaders/subscriptions only. No real account, subscription, external notification or media changed.
remaining: Real-browser configuration, history and cancel/reopen acceptance.
Remaining existing plugin acceptance paths, including large-history scope, must be inventoried.
Complete RSS Context integration and arbitrary 16MiB expanded history remain explicitly unverified; this test does not claim them.
Actual user configuration/KV/reference migration and deployment not performed.
